SBOR-BTC.reason: Published in error. Zest's data contract returned a borrow rate of 0.01% on a market holding $53M, which is the venue not reporting rather than a real rate. Methodology 1.1.0 adds a plausibility floor so a funded market reading below 0.05% on both sides is excluded rather than published. The figure originally published is retained above so the record is complete.

withheld.SBOR-BTC: Withheld: Zest V2 sBTC, this index's only market, has its borrow and supply rates at or near zero on-chain, a level SBOR does not publish as a market rate. SBOR-BTC resumes when a non-zero rate returns.
